historic_survey.note: The sunken plaza by Sasaki, Walker & Associates, its tiered steps with chamfered corners wrapping a BART entrance. When new, the sunny steps filled with office workers at lunchtime - an early local demonstration of the activated urban space that later guided the city's open-space rules.

historical_record.description: Aetna Life and Casualty Building, designed by Welton Becket.
The Aetna Life and Casualty Building, 1969, by Welton Becket and Associates. Its plaza, then Crocker Plaza, was laid out by Sasaki, Walker and Associates in 1969.
